name: design-suite
description: A design lead plus eight focused skills for UI/UX work: user flows and screen states, interface polish (spacing, type, colour, motion), art direction for websites and app screens, accessibility review against WCAG 2.2, dashboards, mobile and responsive design, Apple and Android platform conventions, and information architecture. These are AI review perspectives that give specific, checkable findings; they do not replace testing with real users or assistive-technology audits.

interface.shortDescription: Review and shape UI and UX work
interface.longDescription: A design lead plus eight focused skills for UI/UX work: user flows and screen states, interface polish (spacing, type, colour, motion), art direction for websites and app screens, accessibility review against WCAG 2.2, dashboards, mobile and responsive design, Apple and Android platform conventions, and information architecture. These are AI review perspectives that give specific, checkable findings; they do not replace testing with real users or assistive-technology audits.
capabilities: Frames the user task and reviews flows and screen states
Polishes spacing, type, colour and motion with the project's own tokens
Art-directs websites and app screens from researched directions, checked in a real browser
Reviews accessibility against WCAG 2.2 AA and lists what still needs real testing
Designs dashboards that show freshness and missing data honestly
Plans mobile, responsive and information-architecture changes
Reviews Apple and Android screens against platform conventions
